{{Top|leg}}
The '''Horned Throne''' was the ceremonial seat of the ruler of [[Sintheti]].

==History==
In [[402 BBY/Legends|402 BBY]], several individuals became involved in a succession dispute and made claim to the Horned Throne. Their factions hired [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] groups like the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] and the [[Thyrsus/Legends|Thyrsus]] [[Sun Guard]] to fight for their respective sides. The Guard and the Mandalorians clashed in what would become a three-year conflict known as the [[Battle of Sintheti]].
